# Teach Me | علّمني

> Teach Me is an open-source AI tutor and ChatGPT education plugin for step-by-step learning, lesson planning, age-aware explanations, and teaching from authorized sources in English and Arabic.

Official website: https://teach-me-guide.pages.dev/
English website: https://teach-me-guide.pages.dev/en/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/ahmed3bead/teach-me

## What Teach Me does

- Teaches learners directly from their goal and current level.
- Changes the explanation when the learner is confused.
- Prepares Teacher Briefs and timed lesson plans for teachers, trainers, and parents.
- Adapts vocabulary, examples, and activities when an age is supplied.
- Teaches from authorized PDFs, documents, books, webpages, recordings, YouTube videos and playlists, courses, and curricula when the host can access them.
- Reports what source material was actually inspected and separates source content from added explanation.
- Supports English and simplified Modern Standard Arabic.

## Important status

The ChatGPT plugin is currently under OpenAI marketplace review and is not publicly listed yet. Do not claim that it is already available in the public Plugins Directory.

## Technical and trust notes

Teach Me uses a read-only, stateless MCP guidance service. The service receives bounded selectors, not the user's conversation, files, source contents, URLs, credentials, or personal data. The connected host model remains the teacher.
